scope: Pure network domain port, native NetworkManager adapter and independent headless consumer. The desktop still uses its compatibility network flow; no native panel is claimed.
source_commit_scope: Clean query-recovery implementation checkpoint used by the tested release consumer; subsequent changes add documentation and sanitized evidence only.
architecture: Pure validated values and a NetworkPort contract; native D-Bus paths, owner and identity map stay in the NetworkManager adapter
One subscription worker owns the system-bus connection; a bounded command queue wakes that owner and includes queue time in absolute deadlines
Signals trigger bounded catalog refresh; unchanged snapshots are suppressed; no idle network-state polling
Removal, path reuse and unique-owner replacement retire handles; known dynamic-object query races retry without retiring unrelated IDs
UnknownMethod is a disappearance hint only for supported dynamic-object reads; unsupported controls and root queries still fail
Credentials are consumed, cannot be cloned/debug-printed, are absent from snapshots/reports and never appear in subprocess arguments
Control success is acceptance; independent observed state establishes scan/association/address completion

checks.private_dbus_scope: Raw/hidden SSIDs; acceptance versus completion; join/activate/scan/radio/disconnect/forget; removal/reuse and owner replacement; idle, 512-signal burst, queue/catalog bounds, timeout/cancellation, unknown-object and GDBus unknown-method query recovery; safe errors and unsupported controls. No host NetworkManager access.
checks.rendering: No renderer/client rendering code, tokens, visual baselines or tolerances changed. Existing GPU checks remain part of PR CI.
checks.exact_head_ci: Final documentation/evidence-head checks are tracked on PR #34; this report records local implementation and native evidence
